:::{#def-agreement-test-measures}
#### Test measures estimated from an agreement table

Treating the reference as the truth,
an agreement table (@def-agreement-table) estimates
four measures of the agent:

- its [sensitivity](#def-sensitivity);
- its [specificity](#def-specificity);
- its [positive predictive value](#def-ppv);
- its [negative predictive value](#def-npv).

Each estimate is the matching proportion of the table's cells,
defined when its denominator is positive:

$$
\ba
\Est{\text{sensitivity}} &\eqdef \frac{a}{a + c},
\\
\Est{\text{specificity}} &\eqdef \frac{d}{b + d},
\\
\Est{\text{PPV}} &\eqdef \frac{a}{a + b},
\\
\Est{\text{NPV}} &\eqdef \frac{d}{c + d}.
\ea
$$ {#eq-agreement-test-measures}

:::
